why: The student writes their own method that turns the task into one formula, with double parameters and a double division miles / gallons that keeps the fraction. But the method never returns mpg, so it does not compile ('missing return statement'). New code must be correct to reach L4, so this is a relational answer with an error.

concepts.why: Dividing double by double correctly gives real-valued miles per gallon, but the missing return statement makes the method incorrect.
It only declares double, a primitive type, for its parameters and variable and applies no further rule of the concept.
The answer does not use the % operator.
